lesson: A closed-family regex is tested on the joint text of a candidate, so rewriting an open device node's statement can make the node match the family by itself and silently remove it from every candidate (second occurrence; first was round 5). After any rewrite of an open device node, run generate.py --node <id> and check the scored count. The fix now trusts curated/devices.json for device state, so a device left open after its lane closes it will be offered again.
